target: Tomb Raider 2013 AppID 203160 through the direct glibc route

recall.query: X11 Wine startup white flash offscreen mapped window first paint xwd ImageMagick
recall.reused: existing exact X window class/geometry checks and Android frame-capture method

cause: Wine maps its blank game-sized X11 surface before publishing WM_CLASS; a class-only guard reacts after the white surface is visible.

guard_v3.strategy: snapshot visible IDs, move first new game-sized mapped surface off-screen, confirm exact WM_CLASS, hold through first paint, restore original position

decision: Enable guard v3 by default and retain TOMB_RAIDER_STARTUP_WINDOW_GUARD=off as the exact reverse control.
claim_boundary: One full-rate Android recording shows no white rectangle. The guard retains the existing two-second paint hold and makes no launch-time improvement claim.
